hook: Models predict making element 120 with titanium-50 beams yields only about 18 femtobarns.
summary: Using a dinuclear system model, the study estimates how often titanium-50 beams on berkelium-249 or californium-249 would produce elements 119 and 120, and predicts their alpha-decay chains. The peak cross sections sit well below the upper limits set by earlier GSI experiments. It is a calculation tuned to one measured reaction, and other nuclear mass tables give values up to 25 times smaller.
title: Formation of superheavy elements 119 and 120 in the $^{50}$Ti+$^{249}$Bk and $^{50}$Ti+$^{249}$Cf reactions: dinuclear system dynamics, survival probability, and decay chains of the evaporation residues
